headline: Fronts Stir as Base Ledger Registers New Turns
war_summary: Since the last edition, the base ledger shows fresh movement across several contested sectors. Lykos Isle has risen to 25 events in 24 hours, up from 22, though only one was recorded in the latest two-hour window; its holdings remain divided, five Colonial to two Warden. Tempest Island likewise climbed to 13 daily events, with four in the latest two hours, while its ownership remains eight Colonial to one Warden. Godcrofts has added two recent events after a quiet spell, bringing its daily total to 12, and still stands eight Warden to one Colonial. Fisherman’s Row has awakened with four events in two hours and 12 over the day, its map divided six Warden to three Colonial. Farranac Coast also reports four fresh events, with seven across 24 hours and ownership at seven Colonial to four Warden. Deadlands remains a violent but less active front by the event ledger: seven daily events, none in the last two hours, and an eight-to-three Colonial majority. The major casualty surges at Weathered Expanse, Clahstra, Kings Cage, and other sectors have not yet produced corresponding base events in this packet.
